inputs.text: [excited] Dih… PLOD… oh… kus. In Greek, "diplo" means [curious] double. And "dokos," a beam — [pauses] a big wooden bar.
[happily] Yep — because of the [amazed] shape of the bones in its tail. It lived in North America, a hundred fifty million years ago.
[hesitant] How did it defend itself, with such a long neck?
[confident] With its tail, actually. [serious] Allosaurus and Ceratosaurus preferred going after young ones who wandered off — [calm] a tight herd was a whole different story.
